messages:
Sophie: Heads up — planning a cohort-style community webinar focused on the new OSS tutorial + reference app next month. Need copy for launch post, benchmark narrative (latency/cost angle), webinar script bullets, and inbound routing for registrants. Who can take which piece?
Liam: I can own the benchmark narrative. thinking: show 30% cost reduction with caching + 25% lower p99 latency vs baseline on 2k-token gen. need sample prompts and tokens-per-min stats.
Maya: I’ll draft the launch post + social snippets. prefer gated registration so we can capture seats and route enterprise leads.
Zane: I’ll wire up the webinar registration form and routing. proposal: form -> HubSpot list "webinar-cohort-devcontent-mar" -> automation: if company_size >= 50 -> SDR-enterprise, else -> Growth SDR. Also tag "oss-refapp" for nurture flows.
Nina: Quick note — make sure the copy calls out hands-on quickstart, notebook walkthrough, and 1:1 office hours for 10 enterprise registrants. That drives demos.
Liam: For bench assets I'll need: 1) baseline config, 2) Redwood runtime config used (batching, kv cache true/false), 3) token distribution sample. can someone share sample logs or perf csv?
Sophie: @Liam attaching perf sample in #eng-ml but tl;dr: baseline (no cache, batch_size=1) vs optimized (cache on, continuous batching) numbers look strong.
Zane: form draft: https://forms.redwood.com/dev-webinar-mar (WIP) — has company, role, company_size, use_case, interest_level radio. routing webhook ready at /hooks/hubspot-webinar.
Maya: Post copy first pass: "Join our cohort: Build a production-ready reference app with Redwood Inference — tutorial, benchmark walkthrough, and live Q&A. Limited seats. Register now." Short tweet: "Hands-on: build an OSS refapp w/ @RedwoodInference — live cohort + benchmarks. Seats limited -> register: https://forms.redwood.com/dev-webinar-mar" Thoughts?
Nina: Love the CTA. Add a line about what attendees will leave with: "a deployable refapp, performance checklist, and sample evals."
Sophie: Decision: gated registration, cohort size 150, target dev audience and platform leads. Office hours: 1:1 enterprise slots for first 10 qualifying leads.
marketing-bot: Calendar event created: "Cohort: OSS Refapp Workshop — Mar 15" — link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3410012345.
Zane: Routing detail — webhook will set HubSpot property "source=dev-webinar-cohort-mar" and add list membership. I'll add a Zapier fallback to send a Slack DM to #sales-inbound for company_size >= 500.
Liam: Bench narrative outline: 1) problem statement (serving costs for 2k prompts), 2) experiment (runtime configs), 3) results (cost/token, p50/p95/p99), 4) takeaways & config snippets. Need a short figure (png) for the post and a 1-slide summary for the webinar.
Maya: I'll include the figure in the post. Can you push the figure to /assets/bench-metrics.png here when ready?
Liam: Will do. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Nina: For inbound segmentation: high-intent tag if interest_level = "pilot" or company_size >= 100 and use_case contains "regulated" or "enterprise". Those get a custom nurture sequence + AE outreach.
Sophie: Good. Maya — can you draft the email confirmation with CTA to watch a 3-min pre-recorded snippet & schedule office hours?
Maya: Yup. I'll post copy here in the next 48hrs. Short version + longer version for HubSpot.
Zane: FYI: dev portal PR will include "register" CTA and an embed. I'll open the PR after we finalize copy.
Sophie: Timeline recap: launch post + social ready 7 days before event, registration open immediately after post, reminder emails at -7d, -1d, day-of. Bench figure + slide to finish by EOD tomorrow. Office hours scheduling flow required before registration closes.
Maya: Quick A/B idea for social: A) "Build a refapp" angle B) "Save latency & cost" angle. We can test which drives more signups.
Liam: I'll surface 2 bench blurbs that map to those angles so marketing can A/B easily.
Nina: Add a small lead scoring rule: webinar attendees who attend & download assets -> score +30.
Sophie: Thanks team — assign owners: Liam = bench, Maya = launch copy + emails, Zane = forms & routing, Nina = lead scoring & nurture. I'll coordinate with content ops for publishing.
Zane: Opening a checklist in the content repo: https://repo.redwood.com/content/checklists/cohort-webinar.md (WIP).
marketing-bot: Reminder set for "Publish launch post" on 7 days before event.
Maya: I'll post the first draft here by tomorrow noon.
Liam: I'll drop raw bench numbers here when ready.
Sophie: Perfect. If anyone needs a hand with examples or SQL for hubspot segmentation ping me.
Zane: PR to content repo on deck after Maya's copy.
Nina: I'll craft the nurture emails once we have the attendee segmentation list.
Sophie: Awesome — closing thread, will follow up with a short doc summarizing decisions. :rocket:
